summary: Hines Global Income Trust filed an 8-K disclosing three closed acquisitions. Castings Commerce Center (Columbus, Ohio industrial, ~862,000 sq ft, 96% leased) closed August 31, 2026 for ~$117.0 million; 99 West Paces (Atlanta residential, ~380,700 sq ft, 95% leased) closed September 29, 2026 for ~$237.8 million; and Bishop Arts Portfolio (Dallas residential ~438,000 sq ft plus retail ~49,000 sq ft, 95%/98% leased) closed September 30, 2026 for ~$170.5 million. Sellers were unaffiliated. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or financing terms were disclosed. Watch integration, occupancy, and cap-rate accretion versus NAV.
